In this lesson only manger and habiter are regular French verbs, and both are first-group -er verbs: je mange, tu manges, il/elle mange, nous mangeons (spelling change), vous mangez, ils/elles mangent; j'habite, tu habites, il/elle habite, nous habitons, vous habitez, ils/elles habitent.",
